upstream.sourceTree: External --source-tree input; validated file-by-file against sourceTreeManifest

models.note: The engine image contains source and environment only. The separately mounted, hash-locked model files are not copied into the image or this source package.

excludedFromAceSubset.libsamplerate0: Present in the shared nine-row main audio runtime lock for LeadVocal; it was not in either successful ACE build input set.

nativeAudio.artifactSource: A verified output directory from the shared packaging/ffmpeg source build, supplied to the context-preparation command.

wheelhouse.note: Wheel binaries are external build inputs. The context preparer verifies the exact profile wheel set and hashes; it does not acquire or include wheels in Git.

cuda.recipeNormalization: The promoted recipe uses the profile's current LF-canonical manifest hash and CUDA lock defaults. The recorded successfulRecipeSha256 is the historical raw recipe hash; the context preparer normalizes profile defaults and the source-tree pin before comparing.

rocm.recipeNormalization: The promoted recipe uses the LF-canonical ROCm manifest hash. The recorded successfulRecipeSha256 is the historical raw recipe hash; the context preparer normalizes this manifest default and the source-tree pin before comparing.

aceUpstreamSourceDelivery.scope: The pinned ACE-Step source tree, matching source archive, and upstream MIT license are copied into the tested CUDA and ROCm engine images. This is image-content evidence, not a recipient-delivery claim for the separate build inputs below.

knownCopyleftNativeSources.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later under the retained configure options
knownCopyleftNativeSources.delivery: The exact source archive and build inputs are retained in ignored acquisition/build contexts, not in a recipient source bundle. The image's ACE source archive is not FFmpeg corresponding source.

knownCopyleftNativeSources.archiveDelivery: Exact Ubuntu source archives are in the ignored apt source acquisition set; recipient source-offer integration remains pending.

knownCopyleftNativeSources.license: Packaged LGPL grant; retain Ubuntu copyright notice
knownCopyleftNativeSources.archiveDelivery: Exact Ubuntu source archives are in the ignored apt source acquisition set; recipient source-offer integration remains pending.

knownCopyleftNativeSources.license: LGPL shared-library grant; retain Ubuntu copyright notice
knownCopyleftNativeSources.archiveDelivery: Exact Ubuntu source archives are in the ignored apt source acquisition set; recipient source-offer integration remains pending.

sourceDelivery.gplNativeDisposition: No GPL FFmpeg feature or GPL video codec is selected in the preserved build configuration. This is limited to the reviewed ACE native payload, not a complete transitive license determination for the Python wheel graphs.
notClaimed: Recipient-delivery of the corresponding FFmpeg, libsndfile, LAME, and mpg123 source/build materials; acquired Ubuntu source archives remain in ignored storage.
A complete applicable license-notice review for both ACE Python wheel graphs. This does not imply that every permissively licensed wheel requires its full source archive.
Recipient-delivery of the ACE wheelhouse, FFmpeg output binaries, and native package archives; these remain separately acquired build inputs.
Final source-offer or distribution compliance approval.
sourceDelivery.note: The tested engine images contain the ACE source tree/archive and its MIT license. This package preserves the pinned source, patches, requirements, wheel hashes, native-lock relationship, and build recipes. Ignored source-acquisition records are not recipient delivery. Applicable notices for permissive dependencies and corresponding-source/relink materials for copyleft runtime components remain separate obligations; this inventory is not a compliance determination.

historicalSuccessfulBuildInputHashes.note: These are exact raw CRLF JSON hashes from the successful image build contexts. Current promoted copies use LF line endings with unchanged parsed JSON; they are distinct current artifact hashes, not replacements for the historical records.
